product_overview: A full-stack ticket management system with JWT authentication, role-based access control, and a React-based frontend. Users can register, log in, and manage tickets according to their permissions, while admins can manage users and oversee all ticket operations.
core_goals: Provide secure JWT-based authentication for all protected actions.
Enforce role-based permissions for users, agents, and admins.
Enable ticket creation, listing, viewing, updating, assignment, and deletion through REST APIs.
Support admin user management for listing, updating, and deleting users.
Deliver a responsive React frontend for login, registration, and ticket dashboard workflows.

features.name: Authentication and session access
features.description: Allows new users to register, existing users to log in, and authenticated sessions to access protected ticket and user-management endpoints using JWT bearer tokens.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with valid registration data -> Receive 201 with created user information -> POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token and user payload -> Use Authorization: Bearer <token> on protected endpoints -> Access allowed ticket endpoints successfully

POST /api/auth/register with invalid or incomplete data -> Receive 400 validation error -> POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> Cannot access protected endpoints without a valid Bearer token -> Receive 401 from protected routes

features.name: Ticket listing and retrieval
features.description: Lets authenticated users view tickets according to their role, including their own tickets, assigned tickets, or all tickets for admins, and retrieve a single ticket by ID when permitted.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/tickets/list with Authorization header -> Receive 200 with role-filtered ticket list -> GET /api/tickets/:id for an allowed ticket -> Receive 200 with full ticket details

POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/tickets/list with Authorization header -> Receive 200 with filtered results -> GET /api/tickets/:id for a ticket outside the user's permissions -> Receive 403 forbidden or 404 not found

features.name: Ticket creation and editing
features.description: Allows authenticated users to create tickets and update them according to role-specific rules, including user-owned description edits and admin-controlled status, priority, and broader ticket updates.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/tickets/create with valid ticket data and Authorization header -> Receive 201 with created ticket -> PUT /api/tickets/:id with permitted fields based on role -> Receive 200 with updated ticket

POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/tickets/create with valid ticket data -> Receive 201 with created ticket -> PUT /api/tickets/:id with disallowed field changes such as priority or status as a user -> Receive 403 forbidden or 400 validation error

features.name: Ticket assignment and removal
features.description: Allows admins to assign tickets to agents and delete tickets according to role permissions, while users can only delete their own tickets and agents cannot delete tickets.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login as admin -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> PATCH /api/tickets/:id/assign with a valid agent identifier -> Receive 200 with assigned ticket -> DELETE /api/tickets/:id as admin -> Receive 200 or 204 confirming deletion

POST /api/auth/login as agent or user -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> PATCH /api/tickets/:id/assign as non-admin -> Receive 403 forbidden -> DELETE /api/tickets/:id for a ticket without delete permission -> Receive 403 forbidden or 404 not found

features.name: User management for administrators
features.description: Provides admin-only endpoints to list, update, and delete users in the system.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login as admin -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/auth/users with Authorization header -> Receive 200 with user list -> PUT /api/auth/users/:id with valid update data -> Receive 200 with updated user record -> DELETE /api/auth/users/:id -> Receive 200 or 204 confirming deletion

POST /api/auth/login as non-admin -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/auth/users with Authorization header -> Receive 403 forbidden -> PUT /api/auth/users/:id as non-admin -> Receive 403 forbidden -> DELETE /api/auth/users/:id as non-admin -> Receive 403 forbidden

features.name: Frontend ticket dashboard and forms
features.description: Provides React pages for login, registration, and a protected ticket dashboard where users can browse tickets and perform actions based on their role.
user_flows: GET /login in the browser -> Load the login form -> POST /api/auth/login from the form with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token and user data -> Redirect to /tickets -> GET /api/tickets/list with Bearer token -> Render the ticket dashboard

GET /register in the browser -> Load the registration form -> POST /api/auth/register with invalid data -> Receive 400 validation error -> Correct the form and resend POST /api/auth/register -> Receive 201 and allow navigation to /login -> POST /api/auth/login with new credentials -> Receive 200 with token -> Open /tickets successfully

code_summary.description: Full-stack ticket management system with JWT authentication and role-based access control

architecture.pattern: Monorepo with separate backend (root) and frontend (client/)
architecture.proxy: Vite dev server proxies /api to http://localhost:3000
